Product Description

Real Madrid DNA T-Shirt
T-shirt with regular fit and crew neckline for everyday football style.
Designed for fans who want to carry their passion off the pitch, the Real Madrid DNA T-Shirt blends modern design with versatile style. Whether you're heading to a match or meeting friends, the updated fit and refined details help you look sharp and feel comfortable. Crafted from a soft, single jersey fabric, the t-shirt delivers a smooth feel against your skin, suitable for relaxed days and active moments alike. The regular fit also offers a classic silhouette, not too tight and not too loose, so you can move freely and confidently. A crew neckline adds a timeless touch, while subtle branding nods to your club loyalty without overpowering your look. adidas brings together football heritage and a contemporary look, making this t-shirt a staple for fans and trendsetters. Enjoy the quality and understated pride when you wear it.

Product Details
